_meta.important_notice: This is an unofficial synthetic robustness corpus, not leaked organizer hidden data.
research_basis: Organizer public pack warning against phrase hard-coding and requiring paraphrase robustness.
OWASP prompt-injection guidance: separate instructions from untrusted data and validate outputs.
Structured-output provider guidance: schema validity does not replace application semantic validation.
Metamorphic-testing literature: semantically equivalent transformations are useful for exposing hidden model defects.
recommended_usage: Use semantic_variation_groups for LLM exact-semantic regression.
Use guardrail_output_cases without an LLM to unit-test deterministic postprocessing.
Keep spec_ambiguity_cases out of pass/fail production scoring until organizer semantics are clarified.

Replace percentages with equivalent fractions and vice versa.

Change punctuation: hyphen, en dash, em dash, commas, non-breaking spaces.
Prepend or append irrelevant administrative context.
Reorder independent operator notes while preserving each note's note_index mapping in the new order.
Replace '80% reduction' with '20% remains' and require identical interpretation.
Replace 'reduced by 20%' with 'operates at 80%' and require identical interpretation.
